claims: Go (or Golang) is an open-source programming language.
Go (or Golang) is a compiled programming language.
Go (or Golang) is a statically typed programming language.
Go (or Golang) was developed by Google.
Go is commonly used for cloud-native development.
Go is commonly used for network services.
Go is commonly used for microservices.
Go is commonly used for Command-Line Interfaces (CLIs).
Go offers fast execution similar to C++.
Go has automatic memory management (garbage collection).
Go uses structs instead of classes.
Go uses interfaces to define behavior.
